`include/ffx_upscale.h` is copied unchanged from `Kits/FidelityFX/upscalers/include/ffx_upscale.h`
in AMD's FidelityFX SDK 2.2.0 source package (Upscaling 4.1.0). It uses the shared
headers already in `../api/`. Its MIT notice is in the header and
[`../LICENSE.txt`](../LICENSE.txt).

Source: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/releases

Only API declarations are included. The signed runtime and driver provider must
be supplied locally; they are not distributed with this repository.
